selectedRuleQ14.authority: NEW spell-local authorship except explicit inherited KEEP and retained dependency
selectedRuleQ14.rule: Reflection automatically targets the actual responsible creature dealer, only if that extant creature is within120ft of the recipient and has a real unobstructed line of effect at resolution. No chosen substitute, inferred environmental owner, or controller substitution for a companion dealer. A dead, absent, out-of-range or blocked dealer receives no reflection; no bank. No attack roll, new critical doubling, attack-hit rider or retarget. Hidden dealer identity is retained privately without granting location knowledge. Area components preserve each original recipient; objects/environment with no creature dealer have no reflection target.

selectedRuleQ15.authority: NEW spell-local authorship except explicit inherited KEEP and retained dependency
selectedRuleQ15.rule: NEW exclude reflection-from-reflection. Emit at most one reflected component from this Shell per original selected incoming component/root, and no reflection on a post-defense transfer that bypasses the defense stage. Record consumed causal keys even after replacement/save-load. The reflected packet is new damage: new root, Shell bearer as dealer, parentRoot retained, new Null flag evaluated on that reflector at creation. Pure transfer descendants keep their parent flag and their single original-recipient sharing ledger. Reflected damage passes the actual recipient defenses once and can cause real HP/Wound/concentration outcomes; it does not inherit attack/critical or source on-hit grants. Reciprocal Shells may prevent reflected damage but emit no second reflection.
